strings.d1.s0.name: Römerberg
strings.d1.s0.tips: Rebuilt half-timbered square with the Römer town hall. Empty before 09:30; Christmas market in December.
strings.d1.s1.name: Frankfurter Dom
strings.d1.s1.tips: The emperors' coronation cathedral. Tower climb 3 EUR (328 steps).
strings.d1.s2.name: Kleinmarkthalle
strings.d1.s2.tips: Covered market opened in 1954 with 60+ stalls. Try Grüne Soße (green sauce with 7 herbs), Frankfurter sausage and the wine stand upstairs. Closed Sundays.
strings.d1.s3.name: Main Tower
strings.d1.s3.tips: 200 m observation deck with views of the 'Mainhattan' skyline and the Taunus.
strings.d1.s4.name: Eiserner Steg & Main Kıyısı
strings.d1.s4.tips: Iron footbridge covered in love locks. Cross to Sachsenhausen and walk the riverfront promenade.
strings.d1.b0.name: Zum Gemalten Haus Sachsenhausen
strings.d1.b0.tips: Apfelwein (apple wine) tavern. Order Handkäs mit Musik.
strings.d1.b1.name: Historisches Museum Frankfurt
strings.d1.b1.tips: City history and models. Swap in for the tower.
strings.d2.s0.name: Städel Museum
strings.d2.s0.tips: 700 years of European art: Vermeer, Botticelli, Beckmann, Richter. Museumsufer ticket 21 EUR (34 museums, 2 days). Closed Mondays.
strings.d2.s1.name: Städel Café Holbein's
strings.d2.s2.name: Liebieghaus
strings.d2.s2.tips: Sculpture museum in a villa, with a garden café.
strings.d2.s3.name: Deutsches Filmmuseum
strings.d2.s3.tips: Interactive history of cinema on the Museumsufer.
strings.d2.s4.name: Museum Angewandte Kunst
strings.d2.s4.tips: Richard Meier's white design museum, with a park.
strings.d2.b0.name: Museum für Moderne Kunst MMK
strings.d2.b0.tips: 'Slice of cake' building with contemporary art. Swap in for the Filmmuseum.
strings.d2.b1.name: Maincafé Sachsenhausen
strings.d2.b1.tips: Riverside café with a lawn. Best in summer.
strings.d3.s0.name: Heidelberg Castle
strings.d3.s0.tips: 1 hour by train (RE). Ruined red sandstone castle above the Neckar, with a funicular, the world's largest wine barrel and the Pharmacy Museum.
strings.d3.s1.name: Old Bridge Heidelberg
strings.d3.s1.tips: 1788 stone bridge with the monkey statue, and a view toward the Philosophenweg.
strings.d3.s2.name: Zum Roten Ochsen
strings.d3.s2.tips: Student tavern from 1703. Mark Twain ate here. Order the Schnitzel.
strings.d3.s3.name: Hauptstraße & Universitätsplatz
strings.d3.s3.tips: Germany's longest pedestrian street at 1.6 km. Visit the Student Prison (Studentenkarzer, 4 EUR).
strings.d3.s4.name: Philosophenweg
strings.d3.s4.tips: The Philosophers' Walk on the far bank of the Neckar, with postcard views of the castle and old town. Then take the train back.
strings.d3.b0.name: Königstuhl Bergbahn
strings.d3.b0.tips: Funicular up the 568 m hill, with views over the Rhine plain. Swap in for the walk.
strings.d3.b1.name: Café Knösel Heidelberg
strings.d3.b1.tips: Café from 1863. Try the Heidelberger Studentenkuss chocolate.
strings.d4.s0.name: Palmengarten
strings.d4.s0.tips: Botanical garden from 1871 with a palm house and tropical greenhouse. Lovely in a German spring.
strings.d4.s1.name: Grüneburgpark
strings.d4.s1.tips: Former Rothschild park with a Korean garden and the IG Farben building (now the university).
strings.d4.s2.name: Senckenberg Naturmuseum
strings.d4.s2.tips: Germany's largest dinosaur collection, including a T. rex and Messel fossils.
strings.d4.s3.name: Bornheim Berger Straße
strings.d4.s3.tips: Café street in the 'Bernem' district. Stop at Apfelwein Solzer.
strings.d4.s4.name: Günthersburgpark
strings.d4.s4.tips: Neighbourhood park with a rose garden.
strings.d4.b0.name: Goethe House
strings.d4.b0.tips: The house where Goethe was born, in the centre. Swap in for Senckenberg.
strings.d4.b1.name: Apfelwein Solzer Bornheim
strings.d5.s0.name: Rüdesheim Drosselgasse
strings.d5.s0.tips: 1 hour by train (RB). A 144 m wine alley: touristy but charming.
strings.d5.s1.name: Niederwalddenkmal Cable Car
strings.d5.s1.tips: Cable car above the vineyards to the Germania monument and views of the Rhine bend, in the UNESCO Middle Rhine valley.
strings.d5.s2.name: Rüdesheimer Schloss
strings.d5.s2.tips: Riesling tasting and Rüdesheimer Kaffee (coffee with Asbach brandy, flambéed).
strings.d5.s3.name: KD Rhine Boat Rüdesheim–St. Goar
strings.d5.s3.tips: Boats are limited in winter. Alternatively, take the cable car and walk to Assmannshausen, or visit Eberbach Abbey (The Name of the Rose set).
strings.d5.s4.name: St. Goar & Burg Rheinfels
strings.d5.s4.tips: Town opposite the Loreley with a ruined castle. The train back takes 1.5 hours.
strings.d5.b0.name: Kloster Eberbach
strings.d5.b0.tips: Cistercian monastery from 1136, with wine. Filming location for The Name of the Rose. Swap in for the boat.
strings.d5.b1.name: Breuer's Rüdesheimer Schloss Restaurant
strings.d5.b1.tips: The hotel's own restaurant. Try the Rhine fish.
strings.d6.s0.name: Höchst Altstadt
strings.d6.s0.tips: 15 minutes by S-Bahn. Half-timbered old town, Justinuskirche (830), Bolongaro Palace and the Main ferry.
strings.d6.s1.name: Alt-Sachsenhausen Lunch Apfelwein Wagner
strings.d6.s1.tips: Apfelwein tavern from 1931. Schnitzel mit Grüner Soße at long shared tables.
strings.d6.s2.name: Sachsenhausen Cobbled Streets
strings.d6.s2.tips: Klappergasse and the Kuhhirtenturm tower. Bar district in the evening.
strings.d6.s3.name: Museum Giersch
strings.d6.s3.tips: Art of the Rhine-Main region in a villa on the Museumsufer.
strings.d6.s4.name: Frankfurt Flohmarkt Sachsenhausen
strings.d6.s4.tips: Saturday flea market on the Main riverbank (every two weeks). On other days, walk along the river.
strings.d6.b0.name: Adolf Wagner Apfelwein
strings.d6.b1.name: Ebbelwoi-Express Tram
strings.d6.b1.tips: Nostalgic tram tour with apple wine (weekends). Swap in for the streets.
strings.d7.s0.name: Alte Oper
strings.d7.s0.tips: Opera house from 1880, with a fountain on the square.
strings.d7.s1.name: Zeil & MyZeil
strings.d7.s1.tips: Germany's busiest shopping street. MyZeil is the mall with the glass funnel.
strings.d7.s2.name: Café Hauptwache
strings.d7.s2.tips: Café in the 1730 baroque guardhouse. Say your farewell here.
strings.d7.s3.name: Hauptwache S-Bahn Airport
strings.d7.s3.tips: S8/S9 to the airport takes 15 minutes. Farewell.
strings.d7.b0.name: Konstablerwache Farmers Market
strings.d7.b0.tips: Market on Thursday to Saturday, with an apfelwein stand.
strings.d7.b1.name: Eschenheimer Turm
strings.d7.b1.tips: Medieval tower from 1428. Swap in for the opera.
strings.note0: RMV day ticket 6 EUR (central zone). The airport is 15 minutes by S-Bahn (Europe's main transfer hub). Take the RE train to Heidelberg and Rüdesheim; the Hessen-Ticket is cheap for groups.
strings.note1: December brings the Römerberg Christmas market (one of Germany's oldest). Winter is 0-5°C, so plan for museums (2-day Museumsufer ticket) and concerts at the Alte Oper. Spring is the time for the Palmengarten.
strings.note2: Apfelwein 0.3 l 2.50 EUR (served in a Bembel jug), Grüne Soße 12, Schnitzel 18, museums 8-18. Round up the bill as a tip.
strings.note3: Museumsufer Ticket 21 EUR for 34 museums over 2 days. Städel closed Mondays; Kleinmarkthalle closed Sundays; flea market on Saturdays.
strings.note4: The Bahnhofsviertel (station district) has a drug scene: pass through by day and avoid it at night. For evening bars, head to Sachsenhausen.
strings.note5: Frankfurter Würstchen, Handkäs mit Musik (onion-marinated cheese), Bethmännchen (marzipan-almond cookies), Frankfurter Kranz.
